<MethodEndpoint
  method={"patch"}
  path={"/result/{id}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Changes only the fields sent of a result; the SDK uses it to record the judges' evaluation (`evaluation_status`, `evaluation_notes`, `evaluation_metrics`). A cloud run's token may write results of its own run tree only.
